resources.string: Chip detection provides recommendations and the initial default. The full bundled catalogue and ZIP import are available on every model. Updating the app keeps your current choice.
This driver library requires Android API %1$d or newer. It is visible in the catalogue; selection requires a compatible Android version.
Unisoc T820: choose System driver, MaliSX2 or Unified P48r1 below. Other T820 devices and firmware need their own game tests. Start at 1× and fully restart the app and game after changing drivers.

Dimensity 8300 / 8300 Ultra: choose a driver below. Unified P48r1 uses the same library as the RG477M package. Tests on RG477M do not establish compatibility with every device or firmware. Start at 1× and fully restart the app and game after changing drivers.

Unisoc T618: System driver remains the initial default. All bundled packages and ZIP import are available for manual testing. Actual compatibility depends on the driver and firmware. Fully restart the app and game after changing drivers.
